```yaml
name: Agent Deep Modeling

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Build project
      run: npm run build

    - name: Save user messages
      run: |
        #!/bin/bash
        echo "Saving user messages..."
        # Add your script here to save user messages outside of the workflow
        # For example, you can use a command like:
        # ./save_user_messages.sh
```
